game.name: SoulCalibur IV (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: The famous SoulCalibur franchise returns with the 4th installment. SoulCalibur IV starts where III left off: Siegfried and Nightmare survive their fall and are ready to fight again for the control of the two legendary swords: Soul Edge and SoulCalibur. The Xbox 360 version also features the Jedi Master Yoda as a bonus.
